platforms.title: Delivery Platforms
platforms.helpText: Open or close connected delivery platforms for this store
platforms.emptyHelp: Connect a delivery platform from the admin dashboard to manage it here.
platforms.offline: This register is offline. Reconnect to open or close platforms.
platforms.uncertain: Could not confirm the result. Refresh to check the current status.
platforms.manualClosureNote: You can reopen a platform here at any time. If efood stays closed, it reopens at the first register opening after the next Z report.

reason.moduleDisabled: A required module is not enabled on this register.
reason.unsupported: This platform cannot be opened or closed from here.
reason.wrongTerminal: Manage this platform from its assigned register.
reason.productionNotConnected: This platform is not connected to a live store yet.
reason.busy: The platform is busy. Try again shortly.
reason.outcomeUnknown: Status unknown. Refresh to check again.
reason.outsideHours: Online, but outside the scheduled ordering hours — not receiving orders.
reason.providerForbidden: The platform rejected this change (403). Use its app and ask its support to check API store-status permissions.

sound.title: Order alert sound
sound.help: Choose the sound played on this register when a new platform order needs approval.
sound.mutedNote: App sound is muted, so preview is unavailable. Alerts will resume when sound is re-enabled.
sound.fileHelp: MP3 or WAV, up to 5 MB and 30 seconds long.

errors.invalidType: That file isn't a supported audio format. Choose an MP3 or WAV file.
errors.tooLarge: That file is too large. Choose a file under 5 MB.
errors.tooLong: That clip is too long. Choose a clip under 30 seconds.
errors.decodeFailed: That file could not be read as audio. Choose a different file.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the sound choice. The previous selection is still active.
errors.noImportedClip: No imported clip is available to select.
errors.cancelled: Import cancelled. The previous selection is still active.

weeklySchedule.title: efood weekly hours
weeklySchedule.explain: These hours repeat every week and only affect efood ordering hours. Overnight hours must be split across the two days they span.
weeklySchedule.offline: Reconnect to load or edit efood hours.
weeklySchedule.validationError: Check the hours below: times must be HH:mm, end after start, and ranges cannot overlap.
weeklySchedule.waitingConfirmation: Waiting for efood to apply changes; refresh in a few minutes.
weeklySchedule.staleBanner: A newer schedule was loaded from efood. Reload to see it, or keep editing.

errors.providerForbidden: efood has not permitted this change; contact support.
errors.invalidSchedule: These hours could not be accepted. Check the schedule and try again.
errors.providerUnavailable: efood is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.outcomeUnknown: Could not confirm the result. Refresh to check the current schedule.
errors.productionNotConnected: This platform is not connected to a live store yet.
errors.wrongTerminal: Manage this platform from its assigned register.
errors.moduleDisabled: A required module is not enabled on this register.
errors.moduleRequired: A required module is not enabled on this register.
